title: Section C titles card and AO5 proofreading checklist
subject: English Language
source: Written for english-language/y11 lesson 36 (Section C titles card and AO5 proofreading checklist (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 36. Choose ONE title and write it in 25 minutes. Then proofread for five minutes, reading your last paragraph first.

panels.title: (a) Discursive
panels.text: 'Young people spend too much time looking at screens.' Discuss.

panels.title: (b) Narrative
panels.text: Write a story called 'The Last Train Home'.

panels.title: (c) Descriptive
panels.text: Describe a place you know well as night falls.

rows: Homophones: there / their / they're, its / it's
Paragraph breaks at a change of time, place, speaker or topic

questions.q: Correct: 'its late, the station is empty and there train has gone.'
questions.a: It's late; the station is empty and their train has gone.
